_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: System Baseline Report
summary: The System Baseline Report gives the Government a complete listing using a discrete numbering system to identify the initial configuration baseline and monitor the contractor's hardware configuration requirements.
use_relationship:
The System Baseline Report provides the Government with a complete listing using a discrete numbering system, including an Expanded Ship Work Breakdown Structure (ESWBS)-based Hierarchical Structure Code (HSC), which contains an arrangement where any part of a system, or equipment can be addressed relative to its next higher assembly. The System Baseline Report is used to identify the initial configuration baseline and to monitor the contractor's hardware configuration requirements and allows for continuous updating while in new construction status. It further assists in identifying new provisioning requirements and changes to the configuration.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements as delineated from the work task described in the solicitation.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.
